part.label: ID Tag With Embossed And Engraved Text
part.description: A small identification tag demonstrating both text feature modes on the same target's top face: an embossed (raised) model label and an engraved (recessed) batch code. fontUrl points at a live Google Fonts direct TTF link (Roboto Regular) -- brepjs has no bundled default font, so text features always need a real, fetchable font URL; verifying this example's generated geometry against a real kernel requires network access, unlike every other example in this directory.

features.description: Raised model label near the top edge of the tag's top face.
Recessed batch code near the bottom edge of the same face.
